coverage: MULTI_AGENT single-machine multi-session section now requires two checks before pushing to or taking over any branch this session did not start:
1) git worktree list must show no local worktree holding the branch checked out (a held worktree implies possible unpushed work)
2) takeover intent announced in a comment on the owning Issue before touching the branch
Issue #22 near-miss recorded as the motivating precedent

limitations: Documentation-only change; rules are social contract enforced at review time.
No product source, schema or gate behavior is modified.
